[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 12:12  
[FACT] The user has a holly tree in their backyard.  
[FACT] The user experiences harsh winters in their location.  
[PREFERENCE] The user loves having the holly tree in their backyard and feels it adds character to the space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Holly trees are hardy and can survive extreme temperatures, tolerating temperatures as low as -20°F (-28°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prolonged extreme temperatures can still damage or kill holly trees.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper care and maintenance can help ensure the survival of holly trees in extreme conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips for caring for a holly tree during harsh winters include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Water the holly tree deeply before the ground freezes to ensure roots have enough moisture.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Mulch around the base of the tree to provide insulation and protect the roots.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Protect the tree from frost cracks by wrapping the trunk with burlap or other protective material.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Prune the tree lightly in late winter or early spring to remove damaged or diseased wood.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Avoid using salt to melt ice near the tree to prevent root and foliage damage.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Gently remove accumulated snow from branches to prevent breakage.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Contact a professional arborist if signs of damage or stress appear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips for caring for a holly tree during hot summers include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Water the holly tree deeply once or twice a week during dry spells.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Mulch around the base of the tree with organic matter to retain moisture and prevent weeds.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Avoid fertilizing during drought or heat to prevent root stress.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Prune lightly in late winter or early spring to improve air circulation.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Consider providing shade during the hottest parts of the day.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Monitor for signs of heat stress and adjust care accordingly.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Consider planting heat-tolerant holly varieties or drought-resistant trees in very high temperatures.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] With proper care and maintenance, the user's holly tree can continue to thrive and bring joy to their outdoor space for years to come.
